beats.title: B1 HOOK: every phone screams + the official order
B3 INTRUSION: a phone screams down the hall, then a knock
B5 CHORUS: the floor chat (viewer proxy ignored)
B4 COUNTABLE PROOF: the sender line
B5 LADDER: each door's phone screams first, then the knock, then the same post
B6 ISOLATION: only the enemy's channels still work
B8 MIDPOINT TURN: the alerts were choosing doors
B9 PEAK CONTACT: my phone screams, then my door
B10 LIFELINE UNDER A CLOCK: the only call that rings
B11 TRUTH TWIST: the dispatcher and the door are one voice

items.text: Every phone on my floor screamed at once.
items.screen: COVER FRAME. Lock screen 2:47, alert 1 card: EMERGENCY ALERT · Lindhurst County Emergency Management · SHELTER IN PLACE. Do not open your door for anyone, including emergency services. Further instructions by alert only.

items.text: Open your door for no one. Not even emergency services.
items.screen: Push in on the alert 1 body; caption card NOT EVEN EMERGENCY SERVICES

items.text: Nine minutes later, a second one.
items.screen: Lock clock 2:56; alert 2 drops on top of alert 1

items.text: Previous alert sent in error. County staff are visiting every unit. Please let them in.
items.screen: Alert 2: sender 'Lindhurst Countv Emergency Management'. A 0.3 s hairline glint runs over the v (no VO)

items.text: At the far end of my hall, one phone went off. Alone.
items.screen: Hallway, far end door lit; a faint red pulse under it

items.text: Then a knock.
items.screen: Same hallway, tiny figure at the far door

items.text: The floor chat lit up.
items.screen: Chat 'Ashby Tower · Floor 11', 12 members

items.text: Raf, end of the hall: County jackets. Super polite. They asked how many live here.
items.screen: Raf: 'county jackets. super polite. they asked how many live here'

items.text: Ines, next door: So which one is real?
items.screen: Ines: 'so which one is real??'

items.text: Lorna: The second, obviously. The first was a glitch.
items.screen: Lorna: 'the second obviously. first was a glitch'

items.text: I typed: Then why did the first one say not even emergency services?
items.screen: Me: 'then why did the first one say not even emergency services?'

items.text: Nobody answered.
items.screen: Typing dots start under Lorna, then stop

items.text: So I checked who sent the second one.
items.screen: Alert 2 details

items.text: Not County. C, O, U, N, T, V.
items.screen: Full-frame header card: 'Lindhurst Countv'; letters light C·O·U·N·T·V on each tick; the v gets a red ring

items.text: The open-up alert was fake.
items.screen: Card: 'PLEASE LET THEM IN' stamped FAKE

items.text: Then another phone went off, closer. Knock.
items.screen: Hallway, figure nearer; pulse under door 2

items.text: Raf posted again. All done. Painless. Open up when they knock.
items.screen: Raf: 'All done. Painless. Open up when they knock.'

items.text: Lorna's phone was next, three doors down. Knock.
items.screen: Hallway, figure at door 3

items.text: Then Lorna. All done. Painless. Open up when they knock.
items.screen: Lorna: identical bubble, stacked under Raf's

items.text: Word for word. Even the full stop.
items.screen: ECU: the two bubbles aligned, both full stops ringed red

items.text: I called my sister, Josie. Call failed. My texts sat on sending.
items.screen: Outgoing call 'Josie' -> 'Call Failed'; SMS 'pick up pls' with grey 'Sending...'

items.text: Only two things still worked. The floor chat, and the alerts.
items.screen: Home screen: everything greyed except the chat icon and the red alert icon

items.text: Then Ines posted: Don't open. They're not
items.screen: Ines: 'don't open. they're not'  (bubble ends mid-line)

items.text: That was the whole message.
items.screen: Hold on the cut-off bubble

items.text: Then her phone screamed, right through my wall.
items.screen: Living-room wall; the framed print rattles on the knock next door

items.text: A minute later, Ines posted. All done. Painless. Open up when they knock.
items.screen: Third identical bubble, from Ines

items.text: Then the knocking stopped.

items.screen: Silence 3 s: Tess on the floor, back to the door, phone glow; music hard-muted

items.text: Every door they knocked, the phone behind it screamed first.
items.screen: Floor plan diagram: doors light red in order 1, 2, 3, then the knock icon follows each

items.text: They weren't warning the building. They were picking doors.
And mine hadn't screamed yet.
items.screen: THE ONLY FULL-FRAME COLOUR FLASH: amber on 'yet', then her door lights red on the plan

items.text: I held the power button. It wouldn't turn off.
items.screen: Power-off slider glitches back to the lock screen

items.text: Then mine screamed.
items.screen: Lock screen, alert 3 lands, phone shakes

items.text: Alert three. Spelled right.
items.screen: Sender line 'Lindhurst County' gets a green underline under the y

items.text: Previous alerts sent in error. Admit county staff.
items.screen: Alert 3 body + footer 'Questions? Call 555-0148'

items.text: Three slow knocks. My door.
items.screen: FrontDoor, three knocks, feet shadow

items.text: Now the real sender was telling me to open.
Ms. Avila? County. Your sister Josie called us. She's worried sick.
items.screen: FrontDoor, handle still; warm voice through the wood

items.text: My hand was already sliding the chain off.
items.screen: ECU: her hand slides the chain halfway along the track

items.text: Then I remembered. My call to Josie never went through.
items.screen: Insert: the 'Call Failed' screen again (1 s)

items.text: I looked through the peephole.
He was pressing a phone flat to the glass. On it was my lock screen.
items.screen: Peephole POV: a man in a cap, backlit; a phone pressed to the lens
SCARIEST IMAGE, held 4 s, no VO: her own lock screen inside the lens. Same wallpaper, the three red alerts, 3:09 ticking with hers

items.text: My wallpaper. My three alerts. Behind him, every door on my floor stood open. Dark.
items.screen: Pull back inside the lens: behind him the hall, every door open, black inside

items.text: I put the chain back on.
Alert three had a number at the bottom. I called it.
items.screen: Footer '555-0148' tapped; outgoing call screen

items.text: All night, nothing had connected. This one rang.
Then a key turned in my lock. The door swung in, four inches, and hit the chain.
items.screen: FrontDoor from inside: door open to the chain, a strip of hall light; the chain shudders

items.text: Lindhurst County. Is your door shut?
items.screen: Call screen 'Lindhurst County EM · 00:01' running

items.text: Did you send the alert with the v?
items.screen: Tess MCU, pose ear, whisper

items.text: No, ma'am. That one's fake. Good catch.
And the one telling me to let them in?
That one's ours. Our staff are outside your door.
The chain jumped. The screws were coming out of the frame.
items.screen: ECU: chain plate, screws backing out

items.text: Quickly now. Your name, your unit, and is anyone with you?
Tess Avila. Eleven F. Just me.
Thank you, Tess.
items.screen: Split: the call screen and the four-inch gap; the same words arrive in both

items.text: In my ear, and through the gap in my door. The same voice.
The v was never a mistake.
My phone lit up in my hand.
items.screen: BOOKEND of the cover frame: same lock screen framing

items.text: Tess Avila, eleven F. One occupant. Open the door.
items.screen: Alert 4 card: TESS AVILA · 11F · ONE OCCUPANT. Open the door. Sender spelled right
Hold on alert 4, then hard cut to black (no card, no tail)
